articles.title: Bitcoin faces true demand test above $83K as liquidity thickens: Glassnode
articles.snippet: Bitcoin price analysis reveals convergence of multiple trend lines and liquidity structures around spot price, keeping upside in check.

articles.title: Charles Schwab Expands Crypto Trading Beyond Bitcoin and Ethereum
articles.snippet: The brokerage will expand Schwab Crypto trading to Solana, Avalanche, and Chainlink, but has not given a launch date for the three tokens.

articles.title: Bill Gates Wants a Robot Tax and Jobs Humans Can't Be Fired From
articles.snippet: Gates is calling for AI tokens and robots to be taxed so firms think twice before swapping out workers, plus a bracket of "human reserved" roles that stay off-limits to automation.

articles.title: Galaxy Opens Retail Crypto-Backed Credit Lines on Bitcoin, Ethereum and Solana
articles.snippet: GalaxyOne clients can borrow cash against Bitcoin, Ethereum, and staked Solana at 8.99% APR without selling a coin.
